fc99a28c.r: AI is increasingly capable of writing and debugging code, but the high-level architecture and problem-solving in ML development are massively amplified by AI tools.

n.story:
Your role is transitioning from a manual operator to a precision systems specialist. While the core of your work remains grounded in the physical manipulation of metal, AI-driven computer vision now handles the tedious task of quality inspection and defect detection with superhuman accuracy. You no longer spend hours squinting at workpieces; instead, you interpret high-resolution diagnostic data to fine-tune your grinding processes. 

As repetitive tasks like loading, unloading, and basic surface grinding become increasingly automated through smart CNC systems, your value shifts toward bespoke fabrication and complex maintenance. You will use AI to instantly parse technical manuals and optimize cutting paths for exotic materials. Your expertise is now focused on the 'edge cases'—the custom tools and complex repairs where human dexterity and artisanal judgment outperform any robot.
